Location: Port of Oxelösund, Oxelösund Municipality, Södermanland County
ResearcherNotesProject: Small-scale LNG/bioLNG import + regasification terminal proposed at Port of Oxelösund (east coast, Baltic). MOU signed Aug 2022 between Avenir LNG and port authority Oxelösunds Hamn AB; Avenir to acquire 100% of project company Oxgas AB, which had already secured all environmental and construction permits. Single full-containment atmospheric tank (~32,900 m3 first phase, expandable), regasification to local pipeline + two truck loading bays. First liquefaction was targeted for early 2025 but no construction-start or commissioning confirmation found in 2024-2026 reporting; Avenir LNG repositioned (Oct 2024) toward a pure-play shipping/trading company, so staged as SHELVED pending verification. Capacity expressed as storage m3 (no MTPA throughput published) — reviewer should set CapacityUnits/throughput per methodology. Not in GEM. Entity lookups for Avenir LNG and Oxgas AB returned no existing GEM entity (see entity file).
Source: Avenir LNG press release (11 Aug 2022); LNG Prime; Offshore Energy
